thread:
john_cs: FYI - onboarding for BlueLayer hit a weird auth flap. Desktop tests intermittently get 403 on /v1/generate. Server and CLI tests always pass.

john_cs: Customer pasted this quick repro (token scrubbed):
```bash
# small request -> works
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"hi"}'

# bigger client sends lots of telemetry headers -> fails
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \\
  -H "X-App-Env: desktop" \\
  -H "X-Feature-Flags: a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i" \\
  -H "X-Debug-Trace: 1" \\
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"hello from app"}'
```

john_cs: Failing response when run from their electron build: `HTTP/2 403 {\"error\":\"invalid_auth\",\"message\":\"token missing or invalid for this route\"}`. Request-ids: req_h1, req_h2.

anna_sdk: do we have the raw response headers from the failing case? can they run with `-i` to show headers? Also ask them to try the same failing curl but add `--http1.1` to see if HTTP version matters.

john_cs: they sent headers and ran http1.1. Results: http1.1 -> 200; http2 -> 403. Raw edge log for failing attempt shows upstream proxy rewriting and a 431/large header warning before it returned 403 to client.

pete_net: interesting 44d. this screams HPACK / header compression or header-list-size limit in their enterprise edge. Some proxies, when header blocks exceed buffer, will drop or truncate sensitive headers like Authorization during HTTP/2 reframe handling.

anna_sdk: neat repro candidate: have them append many dummy headers until it fails locally, e.g., `-H "X-Dummy-i: $(head -c 200 /dev/urandom | base64)"` in a loop. If adding headers reproduces, it's definitely a header-list-size problem.

pete_net: mitigation options for onboarding: 1) force HTTP/1.1 in their Electron client (bypass HPACK and header block issues); 2) ask infra to increase header buffer / header-list-size on their proxy; 3) reduce non-essential custom headers from the app.

anna_sdk: for SDK-side work we can add a small opt-in `stripClientMetadata` that omits large telemetry headers by default in desktop quickstart, and a `preferHttp1` flag as fallback. I'll open a tiny ticket.

edge-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-sdk/#4271 add-desktop-header-trim+http1-fallback -> staging 2026-01-08T10:00:00Z

john_cs: customer accepted temporary workaround to disable telemetry headers for onboarding and switched electron to http1.1. They completed the smoke tests. Requested a KB note and a one-pager for infra teams about header limits.

pete_net: follow-ups for CS: capture their proxy vendor/version and exact header-limit setting if possible; include the curl-based repro in KB (`--http2` failing vs `--http1.1` succeeding and incremental header-add test). Also warn that h2 multiplexing can make this intermittent under load.

john_cs: noted. I'll mark renewal-risk as low (they paused 36h) and schedule a 30-min enablement call to walk infra through header buffer settings. Adding transcript and repro to the support ticket now. :thumbsup:

anna_sdk: filed SDK ticket and added unit test that simulates long header lists and verifies preferHttp1 path.

john_cs: closing loop with customer. thanks team!
